name: armor_sweep
description: Manual comparison helper for exercising the same Glock profile across unarmored, armored, and protected-head dummy states. It organizes evidence collection, not authoritative balance conclusions.

steps.name: unarmored
steps.operatorNote: Capture a clean unarmored reference pass with at least one headshot attempt.

steps.name: vest
steps.operatorNote: Compare torso hits against the unarmored pass and log at least one moving shot.

steps.name: vest_headprotected
steps.operatorNote: Attempt torso and head shots so the protected-head path and lethal-headshot evidence can be reviewed.
